subject: Hashtable implementation including unit tests
reason: The change only adds a new, not-yet-used data structure: src/hashtable.c/.h are added and linked into the build, but no server code includes or calls the new hashtable at this commit (only hashtable.c itself and src/unit/test_hashtable.c reference it). No command, reply, replication, persistence or config behaviour changes, so no scenario run against real servers can exercise the new code; it is covered by the unit tests the change itself adds.
